findings.issue: ８つ is read やっつ, not ようつ. The kana transcribes the numeral wrongly, teaching a nonexistent reading.
findings.current: わたしたちのだいがくわようつのがくぶからなっている。
findings.suggested: わたしたちのだいがくわやっつのがくぶからなっている。

findings.issue: Same reading error as kana: ８つ romanized 'youtsu'; correct is 'yattsu'.
Token ８ has reading よう; with the counter つ the numeral reads やっ(つ). よう is not a valid reading of ８ here.
10年 is read じゅうねん, not いちれいねん (digits read one-by-one). Wrong reading of the numeral.
findings.current: だいがくをでてからいちれいねんになります。
findings.suggested: だいがくをでてからじゅうねんになります。

findings.issue: Same numeral error as kana: 'ichirei nen' should be 'juu nen' (10年 = じゅうねん).
Token '10' has reading いちれい (digit-by-digit); before 年 it must read じゅう.
上げる is transitive 'raise/lift (something)' (en pair: 'I will raise it again'); 'I'll get up again' renders the intransitive 起きる/起き上がる, a different verb sense.
findings.current: In three days from now, I'll get up again.
findings.suggested: In three days from now, (I) will raise (it) again.

findings.issue: 'Eu levanto de novo' without object reads as intransitive 'I get up again'; jp 上げる is transitive 'raise it' (cf. en 'I will raise it again'). Sense-changing for the default reader.
findings.current: Daqui a três dias eu levanto de novo.
findings.suggested: Daqui a três dias eu levanto isso de novo.

findings.issue: Same ambiguity as pt: '(eu) levanto' with no object reads 'I get up'; the literal mirror should keep 上げる transitive.
findings.current: Em daqui a três dias, de novo (eu) levanto.
findings.suggested: Em daqui a três dias, de novo (eu) levanto (isso).

findings.issue: 'As for me stepping...' misrepresents the structure: the first clause has conditional/temporal と (as the expl itself says), not topical は; the actual は-topic is 犬. The mirror should read as 'when/and-then'.
findings.current: As for me stepping on its foot, the dog barked.
findings.suggested: When I step on (its) paw, the dog yelped.

findings.issue: 'Quanto a eu pisar...' applies the topic device to a clause marked by conditional と, not は (the は-topic is 犬). Structural mirror is inaccurate and contradicts the expl.
findings.current: Quanto a eu pisar no pé (pata), o cachorro ganiu/gritou.
findings.suggested: Quando eu piso no pé (pata), o cachorro ganiu/gritou.

findings.issue: Wrong rationale for が: in the てから subordinate clause が is the normal subordinate-subject marker, not a marker of emphasis on the speaker. As written it mis-teaches が as emphatic.
findings.current: The subject 私 is marked by が because it emphasizes the speaker within this subordinate stretch.
findings.suggested: The subject 私 is marked by が because subjects of subordinate clauses (here the てから clause) take が rather than は.

findings.issue: Same wrong rationale as expl_en: が na oração subordinada de てから é o marcador normal de sujeito subordinado, não ênfase no falante.
findings.current: O sujeito 私 é marcado por が porque dá ênfase ao falante dentro desse trecho subordinado.
findings.suggested: O sujeito 私 é marcado por が porque sujeitos de orações subordinadas (como a de てから) levam が, não は.

findings.issue: Contextual gloss for 鳴い: 'to quack' fits ducks, not a dog whose paw was stepped on; context calls for 'yelp/whine' (pt gloss already has 'ganir').
findings.current: to quack, to bark, to make a sound
findings.suggested: to yelp, to whine, to make an animal sound

findings.issue: Internal curriculum metadata leaked into learner-facing text: "The target is 'coverage' (general N4 review)." is meaningless jargon for a learner and should be deleted.
Same internal-metadata leak as expl_en: "O alvo é 'coverage'..." não é conteúdo didático e deve ser removido.
findings.current: O alvo é 'coverage' (revisão geral de N4).
